# Shared vectors for the controls contract (STD-033, docs/controls-contract.md), schemas 1 and 2. An operation with the
# suffix 2 (parse2 reject2 fits2 norm2 denorm2) reads its binding as schema 2; without it, as schema 1.
# Every implementation (native/controls/dbce_controls.hpp, Wheelkit's C#) runs all of them.
# Fields are separated by " | ". Normalized values compare within 1e-6; raw values exactly.
#   parse   | text | canonical text
#   reject  | text | reason code
#   fits    | action | text | ok or reason code
#   norm    | action | text | raw | expected normalized
#   denorm  | action | text | normalized | expected raw
#   rescale | value | fromMin | fromMax | toMin | toMax | expected
#   dibutton | DirectInput button byte | expected down (0 or 1): the reader boundary; normalize then takes the boolean
# Device identities are synthetic; the product GUID is the MOZA R12 base's public VID/PID.

# Schema 2 (docs/controls-contract.md section 7): the `cal=` axis attribute, measured endpoints in the binding's
# range. "parse2", "reject2", "fits2", "norm2" and "denorm2" read the binding as schema 2; the plain operations are
# schema 1, where `cal=` is an ignored attribute. Validity is a fraction of S = max - min (S/128 a side, S/8 a sweep).
